title: momipy: A time-resolved momentum microscopy data analysis workflow
summary: Photoemission momentum microscopy is an emerging approach to photoelectron spectroscopy that is transforming electronic band structure mapping at both laboratory-based and large-scale facilities. Its extension to time-resolved measurements has recently enabled major advances, ranging from the femtosecond imaging of exciton wavefunctions to dark-field photoelectron microscopy of light-induced dynamics and strong light-matter interactions. However, the rapid acquisition of high-dimensional data sets (including electron in-plane momenta $k_x$ and $k_y$, kinetic energy $E_\mathrm{kin}$, time $\Delta t$, and more) poses substantial challenges for data handling and analysis. A typical workflow encompasses data acquisition, exploratory visualization, calibration and targeted feature extraction, with data management ideally guided by FAIR principles. Here, we present momipy, a Python package that streamlines the momentum microscopy data analysis workflow efficiently and at low computational cost. Among other features, momipy provides interactive 4D data visualization, energy and momentum calibration, space-charge correction, and a broad selection of multidimensional data analysis routines, including binning, momentum-map extraction and time-, energy- and momentum-resolved model fitting. momipy is accompanied by a selection of interactive example scripts, supporting adoption of momipy by both experienced researchers and users new to momentum microscopy.

AI.tldr: momipy 是一个用于光电子动量显微镜数据分析的 Python 软件包，可高效、低计算成本地简化高维数据工作流。
AI.motivation: 光电子动量显微镜向时间分辨和高维数据采集发展，产生包含动量、动能、时间等多维数据，给数据处理、可视化、校准和特征提取带来挑战。
AI.method: momipy 提供交互式 4D 数据可视化、能量与动量校准、空间电荷校正，以及分箱、动量图提取和时间、能量、动量分辨模型拟合等多维分析例程，并附带交互式示例脚本。
AI.result: 该软件包能够流水线化动量显微镜数据分析流程，降低计算成本，并兼顾有经验研究者和新用户的使用需求。
AI.conclusion: momipy 有助于更高效地处理光电子动量显微镜高维数据，并支持遵循 FAIR 原则的数据管理与分析工作流。

title: Ab-initio study of magnetic interaction in RNiO2: role of rare-earth size and epitaxial strain
summary: In this paper we present a systematic first-principles investigation of the structure and nearest-neighbor magnetic exchange interactions in the infinite-layer RNiO2 thin-film series (R = La-Lu), under the constrain of different substrates. Density functional theory calculations are first employed to optimize the crystal structures, while CAS+DDCI correlated wave-function calculations were used for the determination of the magnetic exchanges. This methodology allows to obtain magnetic interactions in good agreement with RIXS experimental estimations. In the pristine case, our results confirm that the structure of RNiO2 (except for R = La and Ce) adopts the I4/mcm space group, characterized by an out-of-plane rotation of the NiO4 plaquettes. This result remains valid under substrate constrains, even if compressive strain reduces the amplitude of the rotational distortion and leads to an enhancement of the magnetic exchange interaction relative to the pristine structures. The latter are found to depend sensitively on both the rare-earth ionic radius and the applied epitaxial strain. These results highlight the role of structural distortions and substrate-induced strain in tuning magnetic interactions in infinite-layer nickelates.

AI.tldr: 结合DFT结构优化与CAS+DDCI波函数方法，系统研究无限层RNiO2（R=La–Lu）薄膜在不同衬底约束下的结构与最近邻磁交换，发现结构畸变和外延应变可有效调控磁相互作用。
AI.motivation: 无限层镍酸盐的磁性对结构畸变和衬底应变敏感，需系统厘清稀土离子半径与外延应变对最近邻磁交换的影响。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理DFT优化不同衬底约束下RNiO2薄膜晶体结构，并用CAS+DDCI关联波函数方法计算最近邻磁交换作用。
AI.result: 除R=La和Ce外，原始RNiO2采用I4/mcm空间群并伴随NiO4面外旋转；衬底约束下该结构仍成立，压应变减小旋转畸变幅度并增强磁交换；磁交换敏感依赖于稀土离子半径和外延应变，且与RIXS实验估计吻合良好。
AI.conclusion: 结构畸变与衬底诱导应变是调控无限层镍酸盐最近邻磁交换的关键自由度。

title: Large transformation strain of $\mathrm{Ni}_{50}\mathrm{Fe}_{23}\mathrm{Ga}_{27}$ microwires produced by the Taylor-Ulitovsky method
summary: The martensitic transformation and associated tensile strain of $\mathrm{Ni}_{50}\mathrm{Fe}_{23}\mathrm{Ga}_{27}$ microwires produced by the Taylor--Ulitovsky method were investigated using thermomechanical analysis, electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD), and in-situ tensile X-ray diffraction (XRD). EBSD mapping at room temperature reveals cubic austenite in a nonstrained part of the microwire and tetragonal martensite in the strained part. Both EBSD and XRD show that both austenite and martensite have $[001]$ directions approximately parallel to the wire axis. The axial transformation strain calculated from the measured lattice parameters is approximately $15.4\%$. Thermal cycling under constant stresses of $20\text{--}100~\mathrm{MPa}$ reveals experimental transformation strains of $13.2\text{--}14.0\%$. Increasing tensile stress raises the transformation temperatures, with a stress--temperature slope of approximately $1.52~\mathrm{MPa}/^\circ\mathrm{C}$, comparable to that reported for $[001]$-oriented $\mathrm{Ni\text{--}Fe\text{--}Ga}$ single crystals. Overall, the observations confirm that the large macroscopic strain of up to $14.0\%$ relates to the nearly complete martensitic transformation in the microwire.

AI.tldr: 研究Taylor-Ulitovsky法制备的Ni50Fe23Ga27微丝的马氏体相变及拉伸应变，确认最高约14%的宏观应变源于近乎完全的马氏体相变。
AI.motivation: 解释该微丝大宏观拉伸应变的来源，并评估其相变行为与[001]取向Ni-Fe-Ga单晶的可比性。
AI.method: 采用热机械分析（TMA）、电子背散射衍射（EBSD）和原位拉伸X射线衍射（XRD），表征微丝的相组成、晶体取向、晶格参数及恒应力热循环下的相变应变。
AI.result: 室温EBSD显示未应变区为立方奥氏体、应变区为四方马氏体，且二者[001]方向近似平行于丝轴；由晶格参数计算得轴向相变应变约15.4%，20–100 MPa恒应力热循环实验相变应变为13.2–14.0%；增大拉应力提高相变温度，应力-温度斜率约1.52 MPa/°C，与[001]取向Ni-Fe-Ga单晶报道值相当。
AI.conclusion: 该微丝最高约14.0%的大宏观应变与近乎完全的马氏体相变相关，其取向特征和相变行为支持这一大应变机制。

title: Thermal investigation of buffer and transition layers in AlGaN HEMT stacks
summary: In this work, we investigate thermal transport in a set of thin-film layers used in modern HEMT designs. Our theoretical analysis employs three phonon-transport models of increasing sophistication, ranging from a relatively simple Debye-approximation model to a first-principles framework that incorporates Density Functional Theory (DFT)-derived harmonic and anharmonic phonon properties. To describe ternary semiconductors, alloy scattering is also considered, and to account for the properties of non-ideal, polycrystalline thin films, scattering at grain and film boundaries is taken into account. For modeling the specific samples at hand, the latter are fitted to thermal conductivity data measured with Time-Domain Thermoreflectance (TDTR). Overall, we find that the first-principles model performs best and produces the most physically consistent results. Special emphasis is placed on establishing a reliable procedure for determining intrinsic transport properties dominated by Umklapp scattering. Building on these, it is then possible to systematically add additional scattering terms to the models and assess how model-inherent factors, such as the treatment of scattering rates or the description of the phonon dispersion, affect model accuracy and overall predictive capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了三种声子输运模型在HEMT用薄膜热输运中的表现，发现基于DFT的第一性原理模型最优且物理一致性最好。
AI.motivation: 现代HEMT设计中的薄膜层热管理需要可靠的热输运预测，并需厘清模型复杂度、合金散射、晶界/膜边界散射及模型固有处理对预测能力的影响。
AI.method: 采用从Debye近似到包含DFT-derived谐性与非谐声子性质的第一性原理框架的三种递增复杂度声子输运模型；对三元半导体考虑合金散射，对非理想多晶薄膜考虑晶粒与薄膜边界散射，并用TDTR热导率数据拟合特定样品的边界散射参数。
AI.result: 第一性原理模型表现最佳且给出最物理一致的结果；建立了确定以Umklapp散射为主导的本征输运性质的可靠流程，并可在其上系统加入额外散射项，评估散射率处理和声子色散描述等模型固有因素对精度与预测能力的影响。
AI.conclusion: 基于DFT的第一性原理声子输运建模更适合HEMT薄膜热输运预测；通过先确定本征Umklapp输运再逐步加入散射项，可提高模型一致性和预测可靠性，同时模型固有假设会显著影响结果。

title: Alloying effects on the interface cohesion of grain boundaries in the Ni--Fe--Cr system
summary: Grain boundaries (GBs) in polycrystalline Ni-based alloys strongly influence mechanical strength and fracture behavior, yet the effect of alloying elements such as Fe and Cr on GB cohesion remains difficult to quantify systematically. Using density functional theory (DFT), we compute rigid-body separation (RBS) curves for six symmetric-tilt Ni GBs, extracting the work of separation $W_{\mathrm{sep}}$ and maximum traction $\sigma_{\max}$ via the universal binding energy relation (UBER). We find that substitution of Cr or Fe into the GB plane increases both quantities relative to pure Ni GBs. To overcome the size limitations of DFT, we compare several machine-learning interatomic potential (MLIP) foundation models against the DFT dataset and identify a model achieving quantitative agreement with DFT for $W_{\mathrm{sep}}$ and $\sigma_{\max}$. This MLIP enables systematic sampling of alloying configurations at finer concentration steps. We show that alloying-induced changes in GB cohesion depend on both, element type and local structures, revealing trends that are inaccessible with DFT alone. Extending the analysis to a ternary $\mathrm{Ni}_{56}\mathrm{Fe}_{20}\mathrm{Cr}_{24}$ composition, inspired by the principal constituents of the widely used commercial Alloy 718, shows that the binary trends provide a useful basis for interpreting the combined effect of both substitutes, while explicit ternary calculations are required to capture their interplay quantitatively. Together, these results provide a validated workflow for quantifying the effect of alloying elements on GB cohesion in multicomponent alloys. The resulting values may serve as input for continuum-scale fracture models, paving the way toward atomistically informed multiscale modeling.

AI.tldr: 该文结合DFT与机器学习原子间势，系统量化Fe、Cr合金化对Ni多晶合金晶界内聚强度的影响，并建立可扩展至多元合金的原子尺度分析流程。
AI.motivation: Ni基合金中晶界显著影响力学强度与断裂行为，但Fe、Cr等合金元素对晶界内聚的影响难以系统量化，且DFT受体系尺寸限制。
AI.method: 用DFT计算6个对称倾转Ni晶界的刚性体分离曲线，并通过普适结合能关系提取分离功W_sep和最大牵引力σ_max；比较多种MLIP基础模型与DFT数据，筛选出定量一致的模型，以更细浓度步长采样合金化构型，并扩展至Ni56Fe20Cr24三元成分。
AI.result: Cr或Fe替代进入晶界面均提高W_sep和σ_max；所选MLIP在W_sep和σ_max上与DFT定量一致，并揭示晶界内聚变化同时取决于元素类型和局部结构；三元Ni56Fe20Cr24中二元趋势可作参考，但需显式三元计算才能定量捕捉Fe-Cr交互作用。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了经DFT验证的MLIP工作流，用于量化多元合金晶界内聚的合金化效应，所得数据可作为连续尺度断裂模型输入，推动原子尺度信息驱动的多尺度建模。

title: Multicharged Kramers-Weyl Fermions, Quantum Geometric Hall Responses and de Haas-van Alphen Oscillations in WAl$_2$
summary: Quantum geometry of Bloch wave functions and crystalline symmetries play a central role in condensed matter physics, shaping the electronic topology and physical responses of solids. In particular, Kramers-Weyl fermions, spin-split Fermi surfaces probed through quantum oscillations and quantum geometric nonlinear Hall and intrinsic spin Hall responses have garnered significant attention. Despite progress in understanding these phenomena individually, their coexistence with topological surface states, Fermi arcs and chirality dependent quantum geometric transport remains scarce, as pronounced responses involve suitable symmetries, SOC and Fermi surface geometry. Here, we explore this synergy in experimentally synthesized WAl$_2$, considering both structural enantiomers using first-principles calculations and symmetry analysis. We observed twelve Kramers-Weyl (KW) crossings with quantized chiral charges $|C|=1$ and $|C|=3$, accompanied by nontrivial surface states and Fermi arcs. The pronounced metallic character gives rise to six Fermi surface sheets exhibiting antisymmetric SOC, with distinct extremal orbits and candidate spin-split pairs resolved through calculated de Haas-van Alphen (dHvA) quantum oscillations. The electronic structure also exhibits large intrinsic Berry curvature dipole (BCD) arising from the asymmetric distribution of Berry curvature, giving rise to a nonlinear Hall response. The opposite structural handedness of the two enantiomers reverses the chiralities and BCD, reversing the direction of Fermi arcs and nonlinear Hall current. BCD attains $|D_{zz}|\approx0.338$, yielding nonlinear Hall current densities $|j_x|\approx5.04\times10^{10}~\mathrm{A\,m^{-2}}$ and $|j_y|\approx2.52\times10^{10}~\mathrm{A\,m^{-2}}$. We observe enhanced SHC associated with triply charged KW point at $\Gamma$, suggesting role of higher Chern number in the SHC.

AI.tldr: 该文通过第一性原理与对称性分析研究实验合成的WAl$_2$两种对映体，揭示Kramers-Weyl费米子、拓扑表面态/费米弧、自旋劈裂量子振荡、Berry曲率偶极非线性霍尔与内禀自旋霍尔效应可在同一材料中共存并由手性调控。
AI.motivation: Kramers-Weyl费米子、自旋劈裂费米面量子振荡以及量子几何非线性霍尔和内禀自旋霍尔响应各自受到关注，但它们与拓扑表面态、费米弧及手性依赖量子几何输运的共存仍较少；实现显著响应需要合适对称性、自旋轨道耦合和费米面几何。
AI.method: 以实验合成的WAl$_2$及其两种结构对映体为对象，结合第一性原理计算和对称性分析，计算能带拓扑、Kramers-Weyl交叉、表面态与费米弧、费米面、de Haas-van Alphen量子振荡、Berry曲率偶极、非线性霍尔电流及自旋霍尔电导。
AI.result: 发现12个手征电荷为$|C|=1$和$|C|=3$的Kramers-Weyl交叉，并伴随非平凡表面态和费米弧；六个费米面片呈现反对称自旋轨道耦合，具有可分辨的极值轨道和候选自旋劈裂对。体系表现出大的内禀Berry曲率偶极$|D_{zz}|\approx0.338$，产生非线性霍尔电流密度$|j_x|\approx5.04\times10^{10}~\mathrm{A\,m^{-2}}$和$|j_y|\approx2.52\times10^{10}~\mathrm{A\,m^{-2}}$；两种对映体的相反结构手性会反转手征性、Berry曲率偶极、费米弧方向和非线性霍尔电流方向。还观察到与$\Gamma$点三电荷Kramers-Weyl点相关的增强自旋霍尔电导，暗示更高Chern数的作用。
AI.conclusion: WAl$_2$可作为同时承载Kramers-Weyl费米子、拓扑费米弧、自旋劈裂量子振荡、量子几何非线性霍尔和内禀自旋霍尔响应的平台，且结构手性可统一反转其手征拓扑与量子几何输运响应。

title: Lattice dynamics study of (Bi1-xSbx)2Te3 compounds: Comparative compositional study of force constants and Gr\"uneisen parameters
summary: We performed a comprehensive Raman spectroscopy study of (Bi1-xSbx)2Te3 (BST-x) compounds, with varying Sb concentration, under ambient and high-pressure conditions. At ambient conditions, the frequency of all observed Raman-active modes (E1g, A11g, E2g, A21g) is blue-shifting with increasing Sb concentration, albeit with varying concentration-dependent rate. Based on these results, we calculated the relative force constants as a function of Sb concentration using a harmonic approximation, which shows a mode-dependent variation. The force constants for the lower frequency Raman modes (E1 g and A11g) remain almost composition-independent, while for the higher-frequency ones a profound softening (E2g) or stiffening (A21g) was determined. From the Raman spectroscopy measurements under high-pressure conditions, the corresponding Gr\"uneisen parameters for the three observed Raman-active modes (A11g, E2g, A21g) as a function of composition were determined by combining them with the previously reported Equation of States and the corresponding bulk modulus B0 of the ambient-conditions R-3m phase. The average Gr\"uneisen parameter exhibits a clear maximum for BST-07. Based on Slack's equation, these results are directly related to the optimal ZT values for this composition. Our study provides a solid framework for connecting composition, lattice dynamics, and thermal-transport behaviour, towards establishing the microscopic origin of thermoelectric optimization in BST compounds.

AI.tldr: 该文通过环境与高压拉曼光谱研究不同Sb含量的(Bi1-xSbx)2Te3，建立成分—晶格动力学—热输运联系，并揭示BST-07热电优化与平均Grüneisen参数最大值相关。
AI.motivation: 旨在从晶格动力学和热输运角度理解(Bi1-xSbx)2Te3体系中热电性能优化的微观起源。
AI.method: 对系列BST-x样品进行环境与高压拉曼光谱测量；基于谐近似由拉曼模频移计算相对力常数；结合已有状态方程和R-3m相体模量B0确定各拉曼活性模的Grüneisen参数随成分变化，并用Slack方程关联ZT。
AI.result: 环境条件下E1g、A11g、E2g、A21g均随Sb含量增加蓝移但速率不同；低频E1g和A11g力常数几乎与成分无关，高频E2g软化、A21g硬化。高压下A11g、E2g、A21g的Grüneisen参数随成分变化，平均Grüneisen参数在BST-07处出现明显最大值，并与该成分最优ZT值直接相关。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了连接成分、晶格动力学与热输运行为的框架，有助于阐明BST化合物热电优化的微观机制。

title: Reward misalignment as an opportunity for materials discovery
summary: Reward misalignment is usually regarded as a failure of artificial intelligence. In materials discovery with generative AI models, however, disagreement between predefined rewards and expert judgment may reveal materials that the rewards overlook. We investigate this possibility using electronic flat bands as a prime example. Experts mostly agree with a numerical bandwidth score, but their disagreements are systematic and cannot be explained by an estimated 5% rate of mistaken labels. We learn the experts' preferences from pairwise comparisons and use them to guide a crystal diffusion model. The learned preferences and numerical score agree on the flattest bands but diverge elsewhere. For example, the preferences favor KCo2As2 and CoGa, reported compounds with partially flat bands that the score would discard. The framework also extends to synthesizability and phonon properties. Our findings suggest that reward misalignment can expose opportunities for materials discovery beyond what fixed rewards are designed to find.

AI.tldr: 该文提出材料发现中的奖励错配未必是失败，而可能揭示固定奖励忽略的候选材料；以电子平带为例，用专家成对偏好引导晶体扩散模型，发现与数值带宽得分分歧的化合物。
AI.motivation: 生成式材料发现通常依赖预设奖励筛选，但奖励与专家判断不一致常被视为失败；作者检验这种错配是否包含被数值指标忽略的发现机会。
AI.method: 以电子平带为案例，比较专家判断与数值带宽分数；发现专家分歧具有系统性，无法由约5%误标率解释。通过成对比较学习专家偏好，并将其用于引导晶体扩散模型。
AI.result: 学习到的偏好与数值分数在最平坦带一致，但在其他区域分歧；偏好更青睐KCo2As2和CoGa等已报道的部分平带化合物，而数值分数会丢弃它们；框架可扩展到可合成性和声子性质。
AI.conclusion: 奖励错配可作为超越固定奖励设计范围的发现信号，专家偏好学习能补充数值奖励并扩展生成式材料发现空间。

title: Unusual increase in electrical and thermal conductivity of severely deformed CrMnFeCoNi high-entropy alloy: Roles of disordering and nanostructuring in electron and phonon transport
summary: This work investigates how defect engineering and nanostructuring via severe plastic deformation influence electrical and thermal transport in the high-entropy alloy CrMnFeCoNi. High-pressure torsion (HPT) for up to N = 4 turns produces a hierarchical defect structure, including deformation twins at low strains, dislocations and Lomer-Cottrell locks at intermediate strains, and a high fraction of high-angle grain boundaries at large strains. While hardness naturally increases and saturates at ~520 Hv, both electrical and thermal conductivity exhibit an unusual increase upon HPT processing (from 0.953 MS m-1 and 10.3 W m-1 K-1 after homogenization to 1.003 +- 0.005 MS m-1 and 14.4 W m-1 K-1 after N = 4). Analysis based on the Wiedemann-Franz law indicates a modest increase in electron transport (~5%) and a significant increase in phonon transport (~100%) after HPT processing. The phonon mean free path remains small on the order of 0.6-1.1 nm, and comparison with the Cahill-Pohl model shows that heat transport occurs near the minimum thermal conductivity limit, where vibrational modes are strongly scattered. This suggests that the enhancement in thermal transport is not governed by conventional defect scattering, but it is hypothesized that modifications in atomic-scale disorder, such as deformation-induced short-range ordering, are responsible for this unusual behavior. Specific heat capacity increases after HPT, consistent with stored defect energy. The linear thermal expansion exhibits a non-monotonic behavior, decreasing initially due to internal stresses and relaxation effects, and increasing at higher strains due to grain boundary-induced anharmonicity. These findings highlight the complex interplay between defects, atomic-scale disorder, and nanostructure in governing the electrical and thermal properties of severely deformed high-entropy alloys via electron and phonon scattering.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示严重塑性变形（HPT）在CrMnFeCoNi高熵合金中引入层级缺陷结构，反而使电导率和热导率异常升高，并归因于原子尺度无序（如形变诱导短程有序）而非传统缺陷散射。
AI.motivation: 探究缺陷工程与严重塑性变形纳米结构化如何影响CrMnFeCoNi高熵合金的电、热输运，尤其是传统缺陷散射难以解释的异常行为。
AI.method: 采用高压扭转（HPT）至N=4圈制备层级缺陷结构；表征硬度、电导率和热导率，并结合Wiedemann-Franz定律、Cahill-Pohl模型、比热容与线热膨胀分析电子/声子输运及缺陷能量。
AI.result: 硬度升高并饱和于约520 Hv；电导率由0.953增至1.003 MS m-1，热导率由10.3增至14.4 W m-1 K-1；电子输运约增5%，声子输运约增100%；声子平均自由程仅0.6–1.1 nm，接近最小热导率极限；比热容升高，线热膨胀呈非单调变化。
AI.conclusion: 严重变形高熵合金的电热性质由缺陷、原子尺度无序与纳米结构复杂耦合控制；热输运增强并非由常规缺陷散射主导，而可能源于形变诱导短程有序等原子尺度无序改性。

title: Perfumer: A Large Language Model-based Agentic Framework Accelerating Structural Relaxation and Electronic Band Prediction for First-Principle Calculation
summary: First-principles structural relaxation and band calculations require substantial computation and expertise. Here we present Perfumer, a large language model-based agentic framework that couples Quantum ESPRESSO with two predictive models. Across tested structures, pre-relaxation with Perfumer-relax model followed by QE refinement yielded a 2.75-fold overall speedup over QE alone. Perfumer-band model combines a periodic graph neural network with a latent Hermitian spectral head returns 12 band energies at any requested wavevector, preserving reciprocal lattice periodicity and time-reversal symmetry without constructing Hamiltonian. Trained on 125,153 self-curated band structures, Perfumer-band model reaches a median per-material mean absolute error of 0.157 eV on 2,607 test materials, including lanthanide, actinide and magnetic compounds, from held-out composition families spanning 85 elements, taking about 97 ms per material on two consumer CPU cores. The agent turns natural-language requests into relaxation-to-band workflows, from a single uploaded structure to automatically constructed new candidates and returns predicted properties.

AI.tldr: Perfumer 是一个基于大语言模型的智能体框架，将 Quantum ESPRESSO 与两个预测模型耦合，实现从自然语言请求到结构弛豫—能带计算工作流的自动化，并显著加速计算。
AI.motivation: 第一性原理结构弛豫与能带计算耗时且依赖专家经验，亟需自动化、低门槛且高效的解决方案。
AI.method: Perfumer 框架集成 Quantum ESPRESSO、Perfumer-relax 预弛豫模型和 Perfumer-band 能带预测模型；后者结合周期性图神经网络与潜空间 Hermitian 谱头，无需构建哈密顿量即可在任意波矢返回 12 个能带能量，并保持倒格矢周期性与时间反演对称性。模型基于 125,153 个自建能带结构训练，智能体可将自然语言请求转化为弛豫到能带的工作流。
AI.result: 在测试结构中，先用 Perfumer-relax 预弛豫再由 QE 精修，相较单独 QE 总体加速 2.75 倍；Perfumer-band 在 2,607 个测试材料上达到中位每材料平均绝对误差 0.157 eV，覆盖 85 种元素及镧系、锕系和磁性化合物等留出成分族，在两个消费级 CPU 核心上约 97 ms/材料。
AI.conclusion: Perfumer 能自动完成从单一上传结构到新候选结构构建及性质预测的弛豫—能带工作流，降低第一性原理计算门槛并提升效率。

title: Two distinct notions of speed in antiferromagnets
summary: The terahertz resonance frequencies of antiferromagnets characterize their precessional dynamics but do not necessarily imply faster laser-induced quenching of magnetic order. Here, we investigate the distinct roles of magnetic compensation and electronic scattering phase space by comparing ultrafast demagnetization in the antiferromagnetic charge-transfer insulator NiO, the metallic antiferromagnet Mn2Au, and a ferromagnetic Ni reference. The extracted response in Mn2Au is approximately four times faster than in NiO and substantially faster than in Ni. These observations are consistent with exchange-mediated scattering between antiparallel sublattices enabling rapid loss of antiferromagnetic order without requiring net angular-momentum transfer to an external reservoir, provided sufficient electronic scattering phase space is available. In insulating NiO, restricted electronic scattering channels reduces the ultrafast response. Our results distinguish ultrafast demagnetization from exchange-enhanced precession and identify the interplay of spin-flip probability and electronic scattering rate as a key factor governing the nonequilibrium response of compensated magnets.

AI.tldr: 通过比较NiO、Mn2Au和Ni的超快退磁，作者表明补偿反铁磁体的超快响应由交换介导的亚晶格间散射与电子散射相空间共同决定，而非仅由太赫兹共振频率决定。
AI.motivation: 反铁磁体的太赫兹共振频率表征其进动动力学，但并不必然意味着激光诱导磁序淬灭更快；需要厘清磁补偿与电子散射相空间在超快退磁中的不同作用。
AI.method: 对比反铁磁电荷转移绝缘体NiO、金属反铁磁体Mn2Au以及铁磁Ni参考样品的超快退磁响应，提取并比较其时间尺度。
AI.result: Mn2Au的响应约比NiO快4倍，并显著快于Ni；这与反平行亚晶格间交换介导散射可在无需向外部库转移净角动量的情况下快速破坏反铁磁序相一致，前提是有足够的电子散射相空间。绝缘体NiO中受限的电子散射通道降低了超快响应。
AI.conclusion: 研究区分了超快退磁与交换增强进动，并指出自旋翻转概率与电子散射速率的相互作用是决定补偿磁体非平衡响应的关键因素。

title: Constitutive Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks in Finite Element Model Updating: Closed-Form Hyperelastic Strain Energies from Heterogeneous Experiments
summary: Calibrating a hyperelastic constitutive model for a soft material traditionally poses two problems: an expert must choose its functional form, and several homogeneous tests must determine its parameters. Neural constitutive models solve the first, but either remain black boxes or draw on a library of candidate terms fixed in advance. Full-field measurements, such as those from digital image correlation (DIC), promise to solve the second, replacing those tests by a single heterogeneous one. Two gaps remain: flexibility during training with interpretability afterwards, and a way to train such a model on one heterogeneous test. Here we close both. We embed a constitutive Kolmogorov-Arnold network (CKAN) in finite element model updating (FEMU) and train it by minimizing the mismatch between the predicted and the measured kinematic fields and reaction forces. Pruning and symbolic regression then reduce the trained network to a compact closed-form strain energy that satisfies every constitutive requirement. On perforated natural-rubber membranes, the CKANs reproduce the DIC displacement fields with median errors between one and two percent, and transfer to a hole pattern withheld from training. On a perforated silicone plate, a CKAN trained on one stretch profile at a single load reproduces that profile and the measured reaction force to within a few percent. On an aortic specimen inflated under pressure, an anisotropic CKAN predicts the inflated three-dimensional shape. The discovered closed-form energies match the CKANs they replace on the training data and can be compared directly with established models.

AI.tldr: 该文将可解释的本构Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（CKAN）嵌入有限元模型更新（FEMU），仅用单次非均匀全场实验训练，并通过剪枝和符号回归得到满足本构约束的闭式应变能。
AI.motivation: 传统超弹性本构标定依赖专家选择函数形式并进行多次均匀实验；神经本构模型虽可自动学习形式，但常为黑箱或受限于预定义候选项库，且缺乏在单次异质实验上训练并保持可解释性的方法。
AI.method: 构建CKAN并嵌入FEMU，通过最小化预测与实测运动学场及反力的不匹配进行训练；随后采用剪枝和符号回归将训练后网络约简为紧凑的闭式应变能，并满足各项本构要求。
AI.result: 在穿孔天然橡胶膜上，DIC位移场中位误差为1%至2%，并可迁移到训练中未见的孔型；在穿孔硅胶板上，用单一载荷下的一个拉伸剖面训练即可在几个百分点内复现该剖面和反力；在受压膨胀的主动脉试样上，各向异性CKAN可预测三维膨胀形状；所得闭式能量在训练数据上与CKAN一致，并可直接与已有模型比较。
AI.conclusion: 该方法实现了训练灵活性与事后可解释性的统一，能够从单次异质全场实验标定超弹性本构，并自动发现可比较的闭式应变能模型。

title: Emergent Fatigue Dynamics from Foundational Interatomic Potentials
summary: Foundational machine-learned interatomic potentials are trained on large, diverse DFT datasets, but their validation rests on equilibrium states, which does not guarantee correct emergent behavior in large-scale molecular dynamics. Where no direct experimental validation is available, comparisons to physically motivated potentials are valuable for drawing insight. We distinguish static properties, which are thermally accessible, from emergent properties, which require work from an external fatigue stress to drive rare events, and compare the potentials on both. An EAM potential and the NequIP foundational potential both agree closely with reference data for many near-equilibrium properties, but NequIP predicts an anomalously low intrinsic stacking fault energy ($\sim7$ times lower than EAM) and thus predicts far more plastic deformation under fatigue cycling of a nanoscale flaw modeled after the classical Griffith crack problem. Per-atom energy distributions after loading show that the two potentials differ most at energies far above what is thermally accessible. We also document memory-related crashes and silent extrapolation as practical concerns for practitioners of these foundational model forms.

AI.tldr: 基础机器学习势仅在平衡态验证不足以保证大尺度分子动力学涌现行为正确；比较EAM与NequIP发现NequIP本征层错能异常低并导致疲劳下更多塑性变形，同时存在内存崩溃和静默外推风险。
AI.motivation: 大型DFT数据集训练的基础机器学习势通常仅以平衡态验证，无法保证疲劳等罕见事件驱动下的涌现行为正确；在缺乏直接实验验证时，与物理动机势比较可提供重要洞察。
AI.method: 区分热可及的静态性质与需外功疲劳应力驱动罕见事件的涌现性质；用EAM势和NequIP基础势比较近平衡参考数据，并在仿经典Griffith裂纹的纳米缺陷疲劳循环中评估塑性变形，分析加载后每原子能量分布。
AI.result: EAM与NequIP在许多近平衡性质上与参考数据吻合，但NequIP预测的本征层错能异常低（约为EAM的1/7），疲劳循环下塑性变形显著更多；加载后每原子能量分布显示二者差异主要在远高于热可及能量处；还记录了内存相关崩溃和静默外推等实践问题。
AI.conclusion: 平衡态性质一致不足以证明基础机器学习势的涌现行为可靠；需针对罕见事件和高能外推进行验证，物理动机势可作为基准，实际应用应警惕稳定性与静默外推风险。

title: Comparative First-Principles Study of the Physical Properties, Phonon-Mediated Superconductivity and Functional Potential of Technetium-Based Binary Borides TcB2, Tc2B and Tc3B
summary: Phonon-mediated superconductivity in binary transition-metal borides reflects a balance between the metal d-states, metal-boron bonding, and the lattice vibrations that couple to them. Here, we compare P6/mmm TcB2 at 20 GPa with I4/mcm Tc2B and P4/mmm Tc3B at 0 GPa within a first-principles framework. Their mechanical responses differ appreciably: TcB2 is the most rigid under its compressed condition, Tc2B shows the strongest tendency toward ductility, and Tc3B falls between the two. Despite these differences, all three phases remain metallic. The states at the Fermi level are dominated by Tc-4d character, although the extent of Tc-d/B-p mixing varies from one compound to another. Charge redistribution is more directional and B-centered in TcB2, but more delocalized around the Tc network in Tc2B and Tc3B. Inclusion of spin-orbit coupling leaves all three compounds metallic. The optical response remains metallic and electric field polarization dependent, with substantial visible reflectivity and strong ultraviolet absorption. Low-frequency Tc rich vibrations dominate the electron-phonon coupling (EPC). With {\mu}* = 0.10, the Tc values of TcB2, Tc2B, and Tc3B are 24.92, 11.07, and 15.12 K, respectively. Although Tc3B exhibits a higher electronic density of states at the Fermi level, N(EF), TcB2 couples most strongly to EPC-active low-frequency modes, showing that the superconducting hierarchy depends on electronic-phonon matching rather than DOS magnitude alone.

AI.tldr: 本文第一性原理比较了20 GPa下P6/mmm TcB2与0 GPa下I4/mcm Tc2B、P4/mmm Tc3B的力学、电子、光学和超导性质，发现三者均保持金属性，超导Tc分别约为24.92、11.07和15.12 K。
AI.motivation: 二元过渡金属硼化物的声子介导超导性取决于金属d态、金属-硼成键与晶格振动之间的平衡，需要厘清不同Tc-B化学计量和结构相对这些因素的响应。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理框架，对比TcB2（20 GPa）、Tc2B和Tc3B（0 GPa）的力学响应、费米面附近电子结构、电荷重分布、自旋轨道耦合效应、光学响应以及电子-声子耦合（EPC），并在μ*=0.10下计算Tc。
AI.result: TcB2在压缩条件下最刚性，Tc2B最倾向延展性，Tc3B介于两者之间；三者均金属，费米能级态主要由Tc-4d贡献，但Tc-d/B-p混合程度不同。TcB2中电荷重分布更定向且以B为中心，Tc2B和Tc3B中更离域于Tc网络。自旋轨道耦合后仍为金属；光学响应呈金属性且依赖电场偏振，可见光反射显著、紫外吸收强。低频Tc富集振动主导EPC，TcB2、Tc2B、Tc3B的Tc分别为24.92、11.07和15.12 K。尽管Tc3B的N(EF)更高，TcB2与EPC活性低频模耦合最强。
AI.conclusion: 超导Tc高低并非仅由费米能级电子态密度决定，而更取决于电子态与声子模的匹配程度；TcB2因更强的EPC匹配而具有最高Tc。

title: Geometric formulation of the orbital magnetic susceptibility of periodic insulators
summary: A gauge-invariant projector-based expression for the orbital magnetic susceptibility of periodic insulators is obtained from a density-matrix perturbation expansion in a uniform magnetic field. It is shown that, within such an approach, it is natural to distinguish two contributions: the Van Vleck paramagnetic contribution and a geometric contribution. The latter can be expressed in terms of fundamental geometric quantities built from projector derivatives such as the curvature and metric operators, as well as the closely related magnetic moment operator. When applied to two-band and four-band models, the expression for the susceptibility reduces to a simplified formula expressed in terms of the quantum metric. The significance of quantum geometry for the orbital magnetic response is then examined within a lattice model in two dimensions describing the transition between two distinct insulators via a Dirac semimetallic phase.

AI.tldr: 从均匀磁场下的密度矩阵微扰展开得到周期绝缘体轨道磁化率的规范不变投影算符表达式，并区分Van Vleck顺磁贡献与几何贡献；在二带/四带模型中化为量子度规公式，并在二维晶格模型中考察量子几何在绝缘体经狄拉克半金属相变中的作用。
AI.motivation: 建立规范不变、可用投影算符和量子几何量描述的轨道磁响应理论，厘清Van Vleck项与几何项的区分，并理解量子几何在轨道磁化率及绝缘体—狄拉克半金属—绝缘体转变中的物理意义。
AI.method: 对均匀磁场作密度矩阵微扰展开；用投影算符导数构造曲率、度规等基本几何量及密切相关的磁矩算符；将磁化率分解为Van Vleck顺磁贡献和几何贡献；在二带与四带模型中化简为基于量子度规的表达式；用二维晶格模型研究两类绝缘体经狄拉克半金属相的转变。
AI.result: 得到周期绝缘体轨道磁化率的规范不变投影算符表达式；几何贡献可由投影算符导数构造的曲率、度规和磁矩算符表示；二带与四带模型中磁化率约化为量子度规的简化公式；二维晶格模型展示了量子几何对轨道磁响应在相变附近的重要意义。
AI.conclusion: 投影算符与量子几何框架为周期绝缘体轨道磁化率提供了规范不变的分解，并揭示量子几何在轨道磁响应及能带/相变过程中的关键作用。

title: Exact Fractional Chern Insulators from Hubbard Interactions
summary: Laughlin's wavefunction and its parent interaction, Haldane's pseudopotential, underpin our analytic understanding of fractional quantum Hall effect. They are an exact pair in the sense that the wavefunction is the unique, zero-energy ground state of its frustration-free parent Hamiltonian. In this work, we propose exact pairs of many-body wavefunctions for fractional Chern insulators in tight binding models with onsite Hubbard interactions as their parents. The key to our construction is introduction of a Landau-dual Chern band, a multi-orbital Chern band obtained from directly sampling the spin-$s$ Dirac Landau level on a Bravais lattice. The exact many-body wavefunctions are given, analytically, in terms of the matrix coordinate $X+iY+J$, where $(X,Y)$ are the lattice coordinates and $J$ is a nilpotent matrix in spin space. The constructed exact pairs cover the fractional Chern states of the Laughlin, the Read-Rezayi, and the Halperin series. Our results prove that FCI ground states exist beyond ideal bands.

AI.tldr: 该文为紧束缚模型中的分数量子陈绝缘体构造了以在位Hubbard相互作用为母体的精确多体波函数-母哈密顿量对，覆盖Laughlin、Read-Rezayi和Halperin系列。
AI.motivation: Laughlin波函数与Haldane赝势构成精确配对，是理解分数量子霍尔效应的基石；作者希望将这种可解配对推广到超越理想能带的分数量子陈绝缘体，并寻找其母相互作用。
AI.method: 引入Landau-dual Chern band：在Bravais格子上直接采样自旋s Dirac Landau level得到多轨道陈能带；用矩阵坐标X+iY+J（(X,Y)为格点坐标，J为自旋空间幂零矩阵）解析构造多体波函数，并以紧束缚模型中的在位Hubbard相互作用作为母哈密顿量。
AI.result: 构造出的精确配对覆盖Laughlin、Read-Rezayi和Halperin系列分数量子陈态；相应多体波函数以解析形式给出，并与母相互作用形成精确配对。
AI.conclusion: 证明分数量子陈绝缘体基态可存在于非理想能带中，为超越理想能带的分数量子陈绝缘体提供了解析可解框架。

title: Quantum many-body scars and zero modes in the spin-1 Kitaev chain
summary: We study the spin-1 Kitaev chain and, by analyzing its Hilbert-space connectivity in the Cartesian basis, show that it hosts an exponentially large number of exact zero-energy modes protected by chiral symmetry. For even-length periodic chains, their count is lower-bounded by the Jacobsthal number $(2^{L+1}+1)/3$, where $L$ is the chain length. We then construct an exponentially large number ($2^{L/2}$) of zero modes with an analytic expression that have a maximally mixed density matrix for a contiguous bipartition using the operator-state mapping. We further identify an embedded tight-binding structure governing defect dynamics that supports PXP-like quantum many-body scars (QMBS) in multiple sectors previously not reported. The associated forward-scattering approximation (FSA) Hamiltonian takes a universal form across the scarred sectors studied. A simple physical picture of defects propagating between walls provides an intuitive description of these dynamics and a structural guide to identifying sectors with fidelity revivals, while its limitations point to additional scarring mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自旋-1 Kitaev 链，在笛卡尔基下通过希尔伯特空间连通性证明其具有指数多、受手征对称性保护的精确零能模；并揭示由缺陷动力学诱导的 PXP 型量子多体疤痕。
AI.motivation: 旨在理解自旋-1 Kitaev 链中精确零能模的数量、结构及其与量子多体疤痕动力学之间的隐藏联系。
AI.method: 采用笛卡尔基分析希尔伯特空间连通性，结合算符-态映射解析构造零能模，并利用嵌入紧束缚结构与前向散射近似（FSA）研究缺陷动力学。
AI.result: 偶数长度周期链的零能模数下界为 Jacobsthal 数 (2^{L+1}+1)/3；构造出 2^{L/2} 个零能模，其对连续二分具有最大混合密度矩阵；识别出支持多扇区 PXP 型 QMBS 的嵌入紧束缚结构，且 FSA 哈密顿量在所研究疤痕扇区中呈普适形式；缺陷在壁间传播的图像可指导寻找保真度复苏扇区。
AI.conclusion: 自旋-1 Kitaev 链具有指数多精确零能模和新型 QMBS；缺陷-壁图像提供直观结构判据但并非完备，暗示还存在其他疤痕机制。

title: The phase diagram of fluid hydrogen near melting from machine-learned interatomic potentials trained on quantum Monte Carlo
summary: Dissociation of molecular hydrogen increasing temperature or pressure may either occur gradually or abruptly, via a phase transition. Despite considerable experimental and theoretical efforts, the phase diagram of dense hydrogen at temperatures above solid melting is not precisely known. Here, we perform classical and quantum Path Integral molecular dynamics simulations of dense hydrogen using two machine-learned interatomic potentials both trained on quantum Monte Carlo energies and forces. The resulting phase diagram is constructed using state-of-the-art techniques. Both models show a first-order phase transition from the molecular to the atomic liquid terminating in critical points whose locations were determined using finite-size scaling techniques. Triple points, located at the highest temperature of the melting curve, are found at the intersection of the liquid-liquid lines with the melting curve and should lead to clear signatures in ramp compression experiments.

AI.tldr: 使用两种基于量子蒙特卡洛数据训练的机器学习势，结合经典与路径积分分子动力学构建致密氢相图，发现分子液体到原子液体的一级相变、临界点和三相点。
AI.motivation: 高温高压下致密氢的分子解离可能渐变或发生相变，但熔点以上相图仍不精确，亟需确定液-液相变、临界点及三相点。
AI.method: 用量子蒙特卡洛能量和力训练两个机器学习原子间势，开展经典和量子路径积分分子动力学模拟，并用有限尺寸标定等技术确定临界点、构建相图。
AI.result: 两个模型均显示分子液体到原子液体的一级相变，并终止于临界点；三相点位于熔化曲线最高温度处、液-液线与熔化曲线交点，预期在斜坡压缩实验中有清晰特征。
AI.conclusion: 研究给出致密氢熔点以上相图的一致预测，强调液-液一级相变、临界点和三相点，并为斜坡压缩实验验证提供依据。

title: Canted antiferromagnetism and spin-flop transition in honeycomb $\alpha$-Na$_2$PrO$_3$ revealed by angle-dependent torque magnetometry up to 35 T
summary: We report angle-dependent piezocantilever torque measurements on single crystals of the honeycomb magnet $\alpha$-Na$_2$PrO$_3$, proposed to display unconventional magnetism stabilized by anisotropic exchange interactions between spin-orbit entangled, pseudospin 1/2 Pr$^{4+}$ magnetic moments. Previous powder susceptibility observed signatures of a transition at low temperatures to antiferromagnetic order with a weak ferromagnetic moment. From the torque angular dependence in three orthogonal crystallographic planes, we infer a zero-field canted antiferromagnetic structure, with moments almost normal to the honeycomb layers, but weakly canted such as to give rise to a spontaneous magnetization along the in-plane monoclinic $a$-axis, with two magnetic domains related by time reversal. Sharp jumps in the torque angular dependence when the field projection along $a$ changes sign are interpreted as field-induced switching between the two degenerate domains with oppositely aligned ferromagnetic moments. We propose a minimal spin Hamiltonian including easy-axis exchange anisotropy and symmetry-allowed Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) couplings, for which mean-field calculations reproduce the main features of the observed angle-dependent torque. Torque measurements up to 35 T applied almost normal to the layers observe a strong anomaly attributed to proximity to the field-induced spin-flop transition predicted for the above Hamiltonian. We contrast the predicted magnetic phase diagrams for magnetic fields in different orthogonal crystallographic planes normal to the honeycomb layers and discuss how DM interactions convert some transitions into smooth crossovers and stabilize a phase boundary line connecting the spin-flop transition in field normal to the layers to magnetization saturation for in-plane field normal to $a$; such a phase boundary line does not exist in the absence of DM interactions.

AI.tldr: 该文通过角度依赖的压电悬臂力矩测量，确定蜂窝磁体α-Na2PrO3的零场倾斜反铁磁结构，并揭示DM相互作用对磁相图和自旋翻转转变的关键作用。
AI.motivation: α-Na2PrO3中的Pr4+具有自旋-轨道纠缠的赝自旋1/2，且各向异性交换可能稳定非常规磁性；此前粉末磁化率仅提示低温反铁磁序和弱铁磁矩，需确定其磁结构、畴切换及高场相行为。
AI.method: 对α-Na2PrO3单晶在三个正交晶体学平面内进行角度依赖的压电悬臂力矩测量，并在接近垂直蜂窝层方向施加最高35 T磁场；构建包含易轴交换各向异性和对称性允许的Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya（DM）耦合的最小自旋哈密顿量，用平均场计算复现力矩角度依赖并预测磁相图。
AI.result: 由力矩角度依赖推断零场为倾斜反铁磁结构：磁矩几乎垂直于蜂窝层，但弱倾斜产生沿面内单斜a轴的自发磁化，并存在时间反演相关的两个磁畴；当沿a轴的场投影变号时，力矩出现尖锐跳变，解释为场致畴切换。接近垂直层面的35 T力矩测量出现强异常，归因于接近预测的场致自旋翻转转变。计算还表明不同正交平面内磁场的相图不同，DM相互作用可将部分转变变为平滑交叉，并稳定一条连接垂直层面场自旋翻转与面内垂直a轴场磁化饱和的相边界线；无DM时该相边界不存在。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果支持α-Na2PrO3为零场倾斜反铁磁体，并表明易轴交换各向异性与DM相互作用共同决定其畴切换、高场自旋翻转及磁相图；DM相互作用对稳定特殊相边界和转变性质不可或缺。

title: Learning Spin Hamiltonians from Interacting Magnon Spectra
summary: A neural network that learns an inverse map inherits the approximations of the forward solver used to generate its training data. We demonstrate this in the inference of spin Hamiltonians from synthetic neutron-scattering spectra and show how a fast many-body solver can overcome the limitation of linear spin-wave theory (LSWT). We consider a family of anisotropic triangular-lattice spin Hamiltonians at fields just above saturation, where magnon interactions shift and broaden the spectrum in ways that LSWT cannot capture. Using the truncated Hilbert-space ladder (THL) method, we compute the dynamical spin structure factor (DSSF) nonperturbatively within the one- and two-magnon space. THL is fast enough to generate large training sets of DSSF spectra, enabling us to train neural networks that accurately predict Hamiltonian parameters. By empirically benchmarking several neural-network architectures, we find that a one-dimensional convolutional network performs best. A learned forward decoder then reconstructs the DSSF from the predicted parameters, providing a rapid self-consistency check and a visualization of the predicted response. When interactions are strong, networks trained on LSWT and THL spectra infer markedly different parameters. Analysis of the Fisher information matrix shows that the measurement protocol, including which spin-correlation components are resolved and the momentum cut, determines which couplings can be identified. Combining machine learning with fast many- body theory is therefore essential for quantitative Hamiltonian inference from scattering data.

AI.tldr: 神经网络学习的逆映射会继承训练数据前向求解器的近似误差；本文用快速多体方法THL生成动力学自旋结构因子训练集，使一维卷积网络能从合成中子散射谱中准确推断各向异性三角晶格自旋哈密顿量参数，并在强相互作用下克服线性自旋波理论LSWT的局限。
AI.motivation: 从散射数据定量推断自旋哈密顿量参数具有重要价值，但逆模型依赖前向求解器；LSWT无法描述磁振子相互作用引起的谱移动和展宽，因此需要更精确且足够快速的前向模型来生成训练数据。
AI.method: 考虑饱和磁场上方各向异性三角晶格自旋哈密顿量；采用截断希尔伯特空间梯子方法THL，在一、二磁振子空间内非微扰计算动力学自旋结构因子DSSF，并生成大规模训练集；训练多种神经网络预测哈密顿量参数，经验基准显示一维卷积网络最佳；再用学习的前向解码器由预测参数重建DSSF以进行自洽检查和响应可视化；并用Fisher信息矩阵分析测量协议对耦合可辨识性的影响。
AI.result: 一维卷积网络能准确预测哈密顿量参数；学习的前向解码器可快速重建DSSF并提供自洽检查与可视化；当相互作用较强时，分别用LSWT和THL谱训练的网络推断出的参数显著不同；Fisher信息矩阵表明，可分辨的自旋关联分量和动量截断等测量协议细节决定哪些耦合可被识别。
AI.conclusion: 将机器学习与快速多体理论结合对于从散射数据进行定量哈密顿量推断至关重要；逆映射的可靠性受前向求解器精度制约，采用能捕捉相互作用的快速多体求解器可显著改善参数推断。

title: Symmetry-resolved spectroscopy of truncation-induced perturbations in loop tensor network renormalization of the six-vertex model
summary: Tensor network renormalization at finite bond dimension $\chi$ introduces truncation errors that are amplified by the renormalization-group (RG) flow. For loop tensor network renormalization (LoopTNR) on the $c=1$ critical line of the six-vertex model, with Luttinger parameter $K$, we identify these errors operator by operator from symmetry-resolved transfer-matrix spectra and conformal perturbation theory. With $O(2)$ symmetry imposed, the dominant error is the dimerization operator, which is allowed because LoopTNR breaks one-site translation. With less symmetry it is the $U(1)$ current or a charge-two vertex operator. The growth of the dimerization per RG step and a parameter-free ratio of its amplitudes agree with conformal perturbation theory to within a few percent. The parameter $K$ drifts slowly, owing to a weak marginal error and to the running induced by the dimerization. A larger $\chi$ lowers the initial amplitude of the error for $0.75\le K\le 1.5$ but changes neither the operator nor its growth rate.

AI.tldr: 本文用对称性分辨的转移矩阵谱和共形微扰论，逐算符识别有限键维 LoopTNR 在六顶点模型 c=1 临界线上的截断误差，并定量验证其 RG 增长。
AI.motivation: 有限键维张量网络重整化会引入截断误差，且误差会沿 RG 流被放大；需要明确这些误差由哪些算符主导、如何增长以及键维和对称性如何影响它们。
AI.method: 针对六顶点模型 c=1 临界线（Luttinger 参数 K）上的 LoopTNR，结合对称性分辨转移矩阵谱与共形微扰论，将误差按算符分解；并比较二聚化算符每步 RG 增长及其振幅的无参数比值与共形微扰论预言。
AI.result: 在施加 O(2) 对称性时，主导误差为二聚化算符，因为 LoopTNR 破坏单格点平移；对称性较少时主导误差为 U(1) 流或电荷二顶点算符。二聚化每步 RG 增长及振幅比值与共形微扰论符合到几个百分点。K 会缓慢漂移，源于弱边缘误差和二聚化诱导的跑动。增大 χ 可在 0.75≤K≤1.5 内降低误差初始振幅，但不改变主导算符及其增长率。
AI.conclusion: 有限 χ 截断误差的算符结构由对称性和重整化方案决定；共形微扰论能定量描述其 RG 增长，而提高键维主要减小初始误差幅度，不能消除主导误差算符或改变其增长速率。

title: Momentum-space quantum Monte Carlo for twisted bilayer graphene: Interaction effects in the presence of remote bands
summary: Twisted bilayer graphene hosts strong correlation effects within topological flat bands separated from remote dispersive bands. This separation motivates projection onto the central bands, which greatly reduces the computational complexity of many-body calculations, including momentum-space quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) simulations. However, the interaction-induced Mott gap obtained in the projected model can be comparable to the noninteracting flat--remote band separation, raising the question of whether the projection remains valid. Here, we extend momentum-space QMC to explicitly include remote BM bands within a broad energy window at charge neutrality. We find that the projected description remains reliable over a broad parameter regime, up to $u_0/u_1\lesssim0.9$: the projected and remote-band calculations yield similar low-energy electron and trion spectra, and the Kramers intervalley-coherent ground state remains stable. In particular, the Dirac trion remains robust in the finite-temperature normal state when remote bands are included. Near the band-touching limit $u_0=u_1$, remote-band electrons acquire substantial low-energy spectral weight, accompanied by suppression of the trion weight and loss of the Kramers intervalley-coherent state. Our findings establish the broad validity of flat-band projection while reconciling the projected and THF viewpoints by identifying the near-band-touching regime in which explicit remote-band degrees of freedom become essential.

AI.tldr: 该文检验魔角扭转双层石墨烯中平带投影模型的有效性，并通过动量空间量子蒙特卡洛显式纳入远程Bistritzer-MacDonald能带，发现投影在u0/u1≲0.9范围内基本可靠，但在近带接触极限失效。
AI.motivation: 相互作用诱导的Mott gap可能与平带与远程色散带之间的非相互作用能隙相当，因此需要回答仅投影到中心平带的模型是否仍然成立。
AI.method: 扩展动量空间量子蒙特卡洛方法，在电荷中性点处将远程BM能带纳入一个较宽的能量窗口，并与投影平带模型计算结果进行系统比较。
AI.result: 在u0/u1≲0.9的广泛参数区间内，投影计算与包含远程能带的计算给出相似的低能电子谱和trion谱，Kramers interval valley-coherent基态保持稳定，有限温度正常态中的Dirac trion也保持稳健；接近带接触极限u0=u1时，远程带电子获得显著低能谱权重，trion权重被抑制且Kramers intervalley-coherent态消失。
AI.conclusion: 平带投影在广泛参数范围内具有可靠性；同时，近带接触区域必须显式包含远程带自由度，这一结果调和了投影观点与THF观点。

title: Interaction-driven phase transition between bosonic Moore-Read and Laughlin states in a multiple flat-band model
summary: Lattice models with multiple nearly flat bands provide additional degrees of freedom for realizing fractional Chern insulators and studying competition between distinct topological orders. Here we report numerical evidence for the interaction-driven phase transition between the non-Abelian and Abelian topologically ordered states at fixed filling factor in a multiple flat-band lattice model. We construct a six-site Kekul\'e lattice model with two low-energy nearly flat bands whose Chern numbers are $1$ and $0$, respectively. At one boson per unit cell (a site filling of $\frac{1}{6}$), the weak two-body repulsion favors a Moore-Read state predominantly occupying the lowest band, whereas stronger repulsion favors a Laughlin-like state with substantial occupations of both lower bands. We identify the two states by the low-energy spectra, particle entanglement spectra, and many-body Chern numbers, using the real-space and band-projected exact diagonalization, supplemented by infinite density-matrix renormalization group calculations. Our results provide alternative platform to study the quantum phase transition of distinct topological orders beyond the conventional multilayer systems.

AI.tldr: 该文在具有两个近平坦能带（Chern 数分别为1和0）的六格点 Kekulé 晶格模型中，通过数值方法研究了固定填充下相互作用驱动的非阿贝尔与阿贝尔拓扑有序态之间的相变。
AI.motivation: 多重近平坦能带为实现分数量子陈绝缘体以及研究不同拓扑有序态之间的竞争提供了额外自由度；作者希望在超越传统多层体系的平台上研究同一填充下拓扑有序态之间的量子相变。
AI.method: 构建六格点 Kekulé 晶格模型，其两个低能近平坦能带的 Chern 数分别为1和0；在每单胞一个玻色子（格点填充1/6）下引入弱/强两体排斥，并使用实空间与能带投影的精确对角化，辅以无限密度矩阵重整化群计算，通过低能谱、粒子纠缠谱和多体 Chern 数识别相态。
AI.result: 弱两体排斥倾向于形成主要占据最低能带的 Moore-Read 态，而较强排斥倾向于形成同时显著占据两个低能带的 Laughlin 型态；数值证据表明固定填充下发生非阿贝尔到阿贝尔拓扑有序态的相互作用驱动相变。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了研究不同拓扑有序态量子相变的替代平台，不依赖于传统多层体系，并展示了多重近平坦能带中相互作用调控拓扑序的可能性。

title: Current-driven resistive switching in high-field heavy fermion metal UTe2
summary: In UTe$_2$, superconductivity persists up to 70 T for fields tilted by roughly 20-40{\deg} from the b axis toward c. Its normal state is a field-polarized (FP) state, which emerges above a first-order metamagnetic transition when the field component along b exceeds $\sim$35 T. Despite being the parent of this high-field superconductivity, the FP state remains poorly understood, including whether it shares underlying physics with the low-field paramagnetic (PM) state from which it is abruptly separated. Using microstructures fabricated by focused ion beam, we reach current densities of 30-60 kA/cm2 and observe a current-induced high-resistivity state in both the PM and FP regimes over a wide range of field angles in the bc plane. Above a critical current density of order 10 kA/cm2, the resistivity sharply rises to values comparable to those near the critical end point of the metamagnetic transition. The critical current density increases with temperature, opposite to the trend expected from Joule heating, ruling out a thermal origin. The emergence of the same instability on both sides of the metamagnetic transition reveals an unexpected commonality between the FP and PM states. More broadly, the observation of a current-induced transition in a heavy-fermion metal exposes the multitude of nearby electronic states in correlated electron systems and shows that electric current, like magnetic field and pressure, can switch between them.

AI.tldr: 在UTe₂中，通过FIB微结构施加高电流密度可在PM和FP态均诱导高阻态，且该效应并非焦耳热所致，揭示两态共性并表明电流可切换关联电子态。
AI.motivation: UTe₂在磁场从b轴向c轴倾斜约20–40°时可保持超导至70 T；其正常态为b向场分量超过约35 T的一阶变磁转变后出现的场极化FP态。FP态作为高场超导母态仍理解不足，尤其它与低场PM态是否共享物理机制尚不清楚。
AI.method: 利用聚焦离子束制备微结构，达到30–60 kA/cm²电流密度，在bc面宽场角范围测量PM和FP区的电流诱导输运行为，并分析临界电流密度随温度的变化。
AI.result: 超过约10 kA/cm²的临界电流密度后，电阻率急剧升高至接近变磁转变临界终点附近的值；该高阻态在PM和FP两侧均出现。临界电流密度随温度升高而增大，与焦耳热预期相反，排除热起源。
AI.conclusion: 相同电流诱导不稳定性跨越变磁转变，说明FP与PM态存在意外共性；重费米子金属中存在多个邻近电子态，电流可像磁场和压力一样用于在它们之间切换。

title: Fast extraction of universal data from temporal spectrum: Applications to Haagerup CFT and monopole scattering
summary: Extracting precise universal data on conformal field theory (CFT) on the lattice traditionally requires large-scale simulations of the ground states and excitations of critical systems. Here, we propose an alternative accurate and fast algorithm, where we read off the CFT spectrum from the transfer matrix spectrum of an infinite matrix product state after a short imaginary-time evolution. We apply this method to extract the charge-resolved spectrum of a Haagerup CFT to higher levels and obtain a central charge $c = 2.137(27)$. Moreover, we show that the Maldacena--Ludwig monopole boundary can be realized as the ground state of the Fidkowski--Kitaev Hamiltonian after space-time rotation.

AI.tldr: 提出一种从无限矩阵乘积态（iMPS）短虚时演化后的转移矩阵谱中读取共形场论（CFT）谱的快速精确算法，并用于 Haagerup CFT 与 Maldacena--Ludwig 单极子边界的研究。
AI.motivation: 传统上，从格点模型提取精确的普适 CFT 数据需要对临界体系基态和激发态进行大规模模拟，计算成本高。
AI.method: 先对无限矩阵乘积态进行短时间虚时演化，再由其转移矩阵的谱直接读取 CFT 谱；将该方法应用于提取 Haagerup CFT 的电荷分辨谱至更高能级。
AI.result: 获得 Haagerup CFT 的中心电荷 c = 2.137(27)；并证明 Maldacena--Ludwig 单极子边界可在时空旋转后实现为 Fidkowski--Kitaev 哈密顿量的基态。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一种替代大规模临界模拟的准确、快速 CFT 谱提取算法，并建立了特定 CFT 边界态与 Fidkowski--Kitaev 模型基态之间的对应关系。

title: Phase diagram of the attractive lattice Fermi polaron and the instability of Nagaoka ferromagnetism
summary: On the square lattice, the attractive polaron competes not only with the dimeron but also with Yang's $\eta$ dimer, an exact eigenstate that maps onto the Nagaoka ferromagnet. With two-particle--hole Ans\"atze benchmarked by diagrammatic Monte Carlo, we find that the ground state evolves from polaron to dimeron to $\eta$ dimer at low filling, and, beyond a triple point, directly from polaron to $\eta$ dimer. Above 25\% filling it stays a polaron. As the $\eta$ dimer is exact, its boundary is a rigorous instability criterion for Nagaoka ferromagnetism, sharper than the previous best and logarithmic at low filling.

AI.tldr: 方格晶格上吸引极化子与二聚体及Yang η二聚体竞争；基态随填充从极化子演变为二聚体或直接演变为η二聚体，25%以上保持极化子。
AI.motivation: 厘清极化子、二聚体与映射到Nagaoka铁磁体的精确η二聚体之间的竞争，并借此给出Nagaoka铁磁性的严格稳定性判据。
AI.method: 采用两粒子-空穴Ansatz，并用图解蒙特卡洛进行基准校验。
AI.result: 低填充时基态依次为极化子→二聚体→η二聚体；超过三相点后可直接由极化子变为η二聚体；填充高于25%时始终为极化子。
AI.conclusion: 由于η二聚体是精确本征态，其边界构成Nagaoka铁磁性的严格失稳判据，比此前最佳判据更锐利，并在低填充下呈对数形式。

title: Quantum Metric Control of Topological Superconductivity and Incommensurate Charge Density Wave in an Interacting Lieb-Kitaev Chain Model
summary: We study an interacting spinless Lieb-Kitaev chain model in the nearly flat-band regime, motivated by the recent observation that Majorana zero modes in the noninteracting Lieb-Kitaev system inherit two decay modes: an ordinary Bogoliubov-de Gennes (BdG) length and a longer geometric length controlled by the quantum metric. By tuning both the interaction strength and quantum metric, we identify a topological superconducting (TSC) phase, an incommensurate charge-density-wave (ICDW)phase, and a commensurate charge-density-wave (CDW) phase. Inside the TSC phase, the QML is enhanced when increasing the interactions. In the ICDW phase, the interactions are modulated by quantum metric to generate an effective chemical potential, leading to a discontinuous incommensurate-to-commensurate (IC-C) transition. We verify these phases and conclusions using low energy effective theory and density-matrix renormalization group (DMRG) calculations.

AI.tldr: 研究近平坦带中相互作用的无自旋 Lieb-Kitaev 链，揭示量子几何与相互作用协同诱导拓扑超导和电荷密度波相，并产生不连续的不公度-公度相变。
AI.motivation: 受非相互作用 Lieb-Kitaev 系统中 Majorana 零模具有普通 BdG 衰减长度和由量子度规控制的更长几何衰减长度这一近期观察启发，探究近平坦带中相互作用与量子度规如何共同影响拓扑超导和电荷序。
AI.method: 在近平坦带区域构建相互作用无自旋 Lieb-Kitaev 链模型，通过调节相互作用强度和量子度规扫描相图，并结合低能有效理论与密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）计算验证。
AI.result: 识别出拓扑超导（TSC）相、不公度电荷密度波（ICDW）相和公度电荷密度波（CDW）相；在 TSC 相内，QML 随相互作用增强而增大；在 ICDW 相中，相互作用受量子度规调制产生有效化学势，导致不连续的不公度-公度（IC-C）相变。
AI.conclusion: 量子度规与相互作用在近平坦带 Lieb-Kitaev 链中共同决定拓扑超导与电荷密度波相，并可驱动由几何效应诱导的有效化学势和不连续 IC-C 相变；低能有效理论与 DMRG 结果一致支持这些结论。

title: Nonstandard quantum statistics for strongly correlated systems: Superexclusion in momentum space and comparison with exact results
summary: We analyze in detail nonstandard statistics for strongly correlated fermions, which comprise the statistical spin liquid (SSL) and model non-Fermi liquid (NFL) cases. Both of those cases are based on the total exclusion of local doubly occupancies ($the~superexclusion$) either in real space (SSL case) or in reciprocal ($\mathbf{k}$) space (NFL). The results obtained on a purely physical ground are supplemented with the exact analysis of those coming from microscopic Hubbard-like model in $\mathbf{k}$ space. Specifically, we discuss the transmutation of those statistics to that of localized magnetic moments, as well as the transformation of the Fermi liquid into a strongly correlated fermionic liquid or Mott insulating state; the latter taking place for the half-filled-band situation. The role of exclusion of double occupancies in either real or reciprocal space in the appearance of the correlated phase is stressed. Conclusions concerning the universal features of the models, independence of either the real- or $\mathbf{k}$-space representation, are also discussed. One of those is the boson to fermion statistics transmutation which in the limit of strong repulsive interboson interaction leads to the particle localization instead to the Bose-Einstein condensation.

AI.tldr: 论文分析强关联费米子的非标准统计，包括统计自旋液体（SSL）和模型非费米液体（NFL），二者均以完全排除局域双占位（“超排除”）为基础，并分别对应实空间与倒空间（k空间）表述。
AI.motivation: 旨在从物理层面与微观Hubbard类模型出发，理解双占位排除如何驱动强关联费米子体系中的非费米液体行为、局域磁矩形成以及Mott绝缘化等关联相。
AI.method: 结合纯物理分析与k空间Hubbard类模型的精确处理，对比实空间SSL情形和倒空间NFL情形中的超排除机制，并讨论统计嬗变及费米液体向强关联费米液体或Mott绝缘体的转变。
AI.result: 双占位排除可导致统计向局域磁矩嬗变；费米液体可转变为强关联费米液体，并在半满情形下形成Mott绝缘体；强排斥玻色子极限下发生玻色子到费米子的统计嬗变，导致粒子局域化而非玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚。
AI.conclusion: 关联相的出现关键取决于实空间或倒空间中对双占位的排除；相关模型表现出不依赖实空间或k空间表示的普适特征。

title: Scalable Simulation of Strongly Correlated Fermions with Neural Gaussian Tensor Networks
summary: Accurate simulations of strongly correlated electrons remain a central challenge in computational physics. We introduce neural-network Gaussian projected entangled-pair states (NN-GPEPS), which exploit the locally-entangled subspace of Gaussian states to give an architecture more compatible with modern neural networks and an exact contraction cost of $O(N^{3/2})$ on two-dimensional lattices. For the Hubbard model at $U/t=8$ and $1/8$ hole doping, we obtain state-of-the-art variational energies in large lattices of up to 1024 sites. These results demonstrate an accurate approach to strongly correlated fermions by connecting neural networks with Gaussian tensor networks.

AI.tldr: 提出 NN-GPEPS，将神经网络与高斯张量网络结合，以 O(N^{3/2}) 的精确收缩成本在二维格点上高效模拟强关联费米子。
AI.motivation: 强关联电子的精确模拟仍是计算物理的核心难题，需要兼顾表达能力与可扩展性的数值方法。
AI.method: 构造神经网络高斯投影纠缠对态（NN-GPEPS），利用高斯态的局域纠缠子空间，使架构更兼容现代神经网络，并在二维格点上实现 O(N^{3/2}) 的精确收缩成本。
AI.result: 在 U/t=8、1/8 空穴掺杂的 Hubbard 模型上，于最大 1024 个格点的大体系中获得当前最优的变分能量。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过连接神经网络与高斯张量网络，为强关联费米子提供了一种精确且可扩展的模拟途径。

title: Umklapp-enhanced high-$T_c$ topological superconductivity mediated by magnons in $p$-wave magnets
summary: We show that magnon exchange can induce nodal topological superconductivity in a microscopic model of a $p$-wave magnet. Solving the weak-coupling multiband gap equation for itinerant electrons exchange-coupled to localized spins, we find a nodal $p$-wave gap and a critical temperature that rises sharply as the Fermi surface approaches the magnetic Brillouin-zone boundary. In this regime, small-reduced-momentum magnons can scatter electrons between Fermi-surface segments on opposite sides of the zone. These Umklapp processes enhance pairing because the contributions from different sites in the magnetic unit cell cancel less in their electron-magnon vertices than in those for ordinary scattering at comparable reduced momenta. Momentum-resolved winding numbers predict zero-energy Majorana flat bands at symmetry-preserving edges where the bulk nodes project to distinct momenta.

AI.tldr: 磁振子交换可在p波磁体微观模型中诱导节点拓扑超导，并产生零能Majorana平带。
AI.motivation: 揭示磁振子交换驱动节点拓扑超导的微观机制，理解p波磁体中配对增强及拓扑边缘态的起源。
AI.method: 构建巡游电子与局域自旋交换耦合的p波磁体微观模型，求解弱耦合多带能隙方程，并计算动量分辨绕数以判定拓扑节点和边缘态。
AI.result: 得到节点p波能隙；当费米面接近磁布里渊区边界时临界温度急剧升高。小约化动量磁振子可在区两侧费米面片段间散射，其Umklapp过程因电子-磁振子顶点中不同磁单胞位点贡献抵消较弱而增强配对。动量分辨绕数预测在对称保持边缘存在零能Majorana平带，条件是体节点投影到不同动量。
AI.conclusion: 磁振子交换是p波磁体中实现节点拓扑超导的有效机制，并可导致可观测的Majorana平带边缘态。

title: First order vortex-unbinding transition in 2D topological superconductors
summary: We study the fate of the Berezinskii--Kosterlitz--Thouless (BKT) transition in a two-dimensional topological superconductor whose vortex cores each host an isolated Majorana zero mode, energetically well separated from the bulk gap and other bound states of the vortex. When the Majorana localization length $\xi_F$ exceeds the vortex core size $\xi$, nearby vortices acquire an additional short-range attractive channel from Majorana hybridization, modifying the vortex-antivortex interaction at short distances and generating a metastable minimum in the two-vortex free energy above the nominal $T_{BKT}$. We construct an effective field theory for the resulting dilute vortex gas, coupling the ordinary BKT phase field to an additional field encoding the Majorana-mediated interaction, and show, using renormalization-group and instanton methods, that this hybridization can drive the transition first order, with the metastable phase decaying at an exponentially small rate. We propose an array of Josephson-coupled $p+ip$ superconducting islands as a microscopic platform realizing the required hierarchy of scales. Finally, we discuss experimental signatures of this first-order transition, in particular a hysteresis loop whose width is set by the coexistence window.

AI.tldr: 研究含孤立马约拉纳零模的二维拓扑超导体中BKT转变的命运：马约拉纳杂化可把连续BKT转变驱动为一阶转变。
AI.motivation: 当马约拉纳局域长度ξ_F超过涡旋核尺寸ξ时，近邻涡旋间会通过马约拉纳杂化获得额外短程吸引通道，从而改变涡旋-反涡旋相互作用并可能改变BKT转变性质。
AI.method: 构造描述稀薄涡旋气体的有效场论，将普通BKT相位场与编码马约拉纳介导相互作用的附加场耦合，并用重整化群和瞬子方法分析相变及亚稳相衰变。
AI.result: 马约拉纳杂化在名义T_BKT以上产生两涡旋自由能的亚稳极小；该机制可驱动转变变为一阶，亚稳相以指数小速率衰变；提出约瑟夫森耦合的p+ip超导岛阵列作为实现所需尺度层级的微观平台。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明马约拉纳零模杂化可显著改变二维拓扑超导体中涡旋BKT物理，预言一阶转变及由共存窗口决定宽度的滞回实验特征。

title: Magnetic order in Tb and Dy substituted La3Ni2O7 and effects of high-pressure high-temperature O2 annealing
summary: To study the influence of magnetic lanthanide (Ln) substituents on La3Ni2O7, polycrystalline samples of La3-xLnxNi2O7 (Ln = Pr, Eu, Gd, Tb, Dy, Ho, Er, Tm, and Yb) were synthesized and characterized by electrical transport, magnetization, and x-ray and neutron powder diffraction before and after high-pressure high-temperature oxygen annealing. The annealing process led to the formation of La3Ni2O7 polymorphs and more metallic-like temperature dependence of the electrical resistance while changing the density-wave transition temperature only slightly. For unannealed La2.7Tb0.3Ni2O7 and La2.7Dy0.3Ni2O7, distinct features in the magnetic susceptibility and additional magnetic peaks in neutron diffraction patterns indicate that both samples develop long-range magnetic order below ~13 and 11 K, respectively. The magnetic signatures were strongly suppressed following oxygen annealing, suggesting a possible association with the accompanying structural modifications. These behaviors distinguish Tb and Dy from Pr, Nd, and Sm substituents which do not introduce magnetic ordering in the system, establishing La3-xTbxNi2O7 and La3-xDyxNi2O7 as promising platforms for exploring the interplay between magnetic order and pressure-induced superconductivity in La3Ni2O7.

AI.tldr: 研究了磁性镧系取代对La3Ni2O7结构与物性的影响，发现Tb、Dy取代样品在低温出现长程磁有序，而氧退火会强烈抑制该磁性。
AI.motivation: 探索La3Ni2O7中磁性镧系取代对密度波、磁性与压力诱导超导电性之间相互作用的调控作用。
AI.method: 合成La3-xLnxNi2O7（Ln = Pr、Eu、Gd、Tb、Dy、Ho、Er、Tm、Yb）多晶样品，并结合电输运、磁化测量以及X射线和中子粉末衍射，在高压高温氧退火前后进行表征。
AI.result: 氧退火形成La3Ni2O7多晶型，使电阻温度依赖更偏金属性，而密度波转变温度仅轻微变化；未退火La2.7Tb0.3Ni2O7和La2.7Dy0.3Ni2O7分别在约13 K和11 K以下表现长程磁有序，氧退火后磁信号被强烈抑制，并与结构修饰相关。
AI.conclusion: Tb和Dy取代可引入磁有序，区别于不引入磁有序的Pr、Nd、Sm取代，使La3-xTbxNi2O7和La3-xDyxNi2O7成为研究磁有序与压力诱导超导电性相互作用的候选平台。

title: Generalized Critical-State Analysis of Local Field Screening in High-Pressure Yttrium Polyhydride
summary: We resolve the long-standing controversy over the interpretation of magnetic-flux expulsion in high-pressure superhydrides by measuring the local magnetic field adjacent to yttrium polyhydride at 171 GPa and 4.1 K with a $^{57}$Fe M\"ossbauer sensor. Nuclear forward scattering tracks the local induction $B_{\rm sensor}(B_a)$, which nearly merges with the normal-state line near 1.5 T. Rather than assuming a constant-current Bean state, we solve the critical-state problem for the actual thin-disk geometry using the Shantsev--Clem--Sanchez method and compare generalized field-dependent critical-state models. Both the Kim and exponential laws reproduce the measured virgin branch, whereas the constant-$J_c$ Bean model fails. The corresponding zero-field critical-current densities, $(4.38\pm1.48)\times10^{11}$ and $(2.45\pm0.22)\times10^{11}$ A/m$^2$, respectively, are consistent in order of magnitude with transport estimates for granular YH$_6$. These results establish that the observed flux expulsion is a pinned critical state, not the equilibrium Meissner effect, and demonstrate a general methodology for probing local superconductivity under extreme conditions.

AI.tldr: 该工作通过局域磁场测量与临界态建模，证明高压超氢化物中的磁通排出是钉扎临界态而非平衡迈斯纳效应。
AI.motivation: 高压超氢化物中磁通排出（抗磁性）的解释长期存在争议：它可能反映本征迈斯纳效应，也可能源于钉扎引起的临界态。
AI.method: 在171 GPa、4.1 K下用$^{57}$Fe Mössbauer传感器测量钇多氢化物附近的局域磁场，通过核前向散射跟踪$B_{\rm sensor}(B_a)$；并针对薄盘几何用Shantsev--Clem--Sanchez方法求解临界态问题，比较场依赖的广义临界态模型。
AI.result: $B_{\rm sensor}(B_a)$在约1.5 T附近接近正常态线；Kim模型和指数模型均能重现初始磁化分支，而恒定$J_c$的Bean模型失败。由二者得到的零场临界电流密度分别为$(4.38\pm1.48)\times10^{11}$和$(2.45\pm0.22)\times10^{11}$ A/m$^2$，与颗粒状YH$_6$的输运估计在数量级上一致。
AI.conclusion: 观测到的磁通排出是钉扎临界态，而非平衡迈斯纳效应；该研究建立了在极端条件下探测局域超导性的通用方法。

title: Can Language Models Build Molecules in Three Dimensions?
summary: Chemical drawings convey which atoms are bonded and how stereocentres are configured, but not molecular shape. Every simulation starts from three-dimensional coordinates, and building them from a drawing remains a manual step. We introduce MolDraft, a curated benchmark of 300 drawing-structure pairs spanning natural products, hypervalent compounds, and coordination complexes. Given an image and a short instruction, an AI system must generate a complete set of atomic coordinates, which are checked for molecular identity, stereochemical configuration, and coarse ligand geometry. We evaluate nine multimodal language models using the same agent setup. The share of molecules built correctly, the resolve rate, ranges from 25.0% to 76.0% and falls as molecules grow, most sharply above about 80 atoms. Only 29 of the 300 molecules are resolved by all nine models, and literature structures, mostly metal complexes, are the hardest source for every model. Language models can thus build many molecules in three dimensions, but not yet reliably reproduce the coordination chemistry of the research literature.

AI.tldr: 提出 MolDraft 基准，评估多模态语言模型能否从化学结构图直接生成完整三维原子坐标。
AI.motivation: 化学结构图只表达键连与立体中心构型，不包含分子形状；而所有模拟都需要三维坐标，目前从结构图构建三维坐标仍是人工步骤。
AI.method: 构建含300个绘图-结构对的 curated benchmark，覆盖天然产物、超价化合物和配位配合物；给定图像和简短指令，AI需生成完整原子坐标，并从分子身份、立体化学构型和粗粒度配体几何三方面检查；用统一agent设置评估九个多模态语言模型。
AI.result: 九模型正确构建分子的resolve rate为25.0%至76.0%，随分子增大而下降，约80个原子以上下降最明显；300个分子中仅29个被全部九模型解决；文献结构（多为金属配合物）对所有模型都最难。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型已能从图像构建许多分子的三维结构，但尚不能可靠复现研究文献中的配位化学结构。

title: MAPPA: Mapping of Atoms by Progressive Pattern Assembly with Molecular Symmetry
summary: Atom-to-atom mapping traces atom identities between molecular endpoints, supporting reaction anal- ysis and pathway construction. Yet the same endpoints can admit multiple correspondences, and selecting a single answer can conceal alternatives with different chemical implications. We introduce MAPPA, a framework that efficiently discovers and retains alternative atom mappings. It uses shared molecular fragments and molecular symmetry to represent these alternatives compactly, allowing their bond changes to be examined and supporting subsequent chemistry-aware selection. MAPPA achieves the highest reference coverage among the evaluated methods on Golden. Standard benchmark runs re- cover 99.03% of Golden and 99.63% of EnzymeMap reference mappings, with matching and decoding together averaging 3.19 and 13.16 CPU seconds per reaction, respectively. Broader exploration raises Golden coverage to 99.51%. These results make broad exploration of mapping alternatives practical, providing a foundation for studying reaction ambiguity and incorporating chemical knowledge into mapping selection.

AI.tldr: MAPPA 是一个高效发现并保留多组替代原子映射的框架，利用共享分子片段与对称性紧凑表示映射替代方案，并在基准上取得高覆盖率与可接受的计算开销。
AI.motivation: 原子到原子映射用于追踪分子端点间的原子身份，但同一反应端点可能存在多种对应关系；只选单一映射会掩盖具有不同化学含义的替代方案。
AI.method: MAPPA 通过共享分子片段和分子对称性紧凑表示多种替代原子映射，使这些映射的键变化可被检查，并支持后续化学感知的映射选择。
AI.result: 在评估方法中 Golden 参考覆盖率最高；标准基准运行分别恢复 Golden 的 99.03% 和 EnzymeMap 参考映射的 99.63%，匹配与解码平均每反应耗时 3.19 和 13.16 CPU 秒；更广泛探索将 Golden 覆盖率提升至 99.51%。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果使广泛探索映射替代方案变得可行，为研究反应歧义及将化学知识纳入映射选择提供了基础。

title: Witnessing Molecular Conformation via Optical Cycling Centers
summary: Molecular conformation plays a central role in determining molecular properties and dynamics. Here, we report the production and conformer-resolved spectroscopy of cold calcium 3-hydroxyphenoxide radical (CaOC$_6$H$_4$-3-OH) in a cryogenic buffer-gas cell. Internal rotation of the hydroxyl group gives rise to distinct $anti$- and $syn$-conformers. The CaO moiety acts as an optical cycling center (OCC), enabling the $\widetilde A - \widetilde X$ and $\widetilde B - \widetilde X$ transitions of both conformers to be resolved by laser-induced fluorescence spectroscopy. Dispersed fluorescence measurements reveal diagonal vibrational branching fractions of 0.91-0.93, indicating favorable optical cycling characteristics. Following excitation of off-diagonal vibronic transitions near the calculated torsional barrier in the $\widetilde A$ state, the emission remains predominantly conformer specific, indicating that conformational identity is largely preserved over the excited-state fluorescence lifetime. These results demonstrate that a metal-centered OCC can serve as an intrinsic, site-specific optical reporter of molecular conformation, providing a foundation for repetitive optical readout and studies of conformational dynamics at the single-molecule level.

AI.tldr: 该文报道在低温缓冲气池中制备冷钙3-羟基苯氧基自由基（CaOC6H4-3-OH），并实现构象分辨光谱；利用CaO作为光学循环中心分辨anti/syn构象，评估其光循环特性及激发态寿命内的构象保持。
AI.motivation: 分子构象决定分子性质与动力学，需要一种位点特异、可用于重复光学读出并研究单分子构象动力学的内在光学报告基团。
AI.method: 在低温缓冲气细胞中产生冷CaOC6H4-3-OH自由基，用激光诱导荧光光谱分辨anti-和syn-构象的Ã-X̃与B̃-X̃跃迁；通过色散荧光测量振动分支比，并激发接近Ã态扭转势垒的非对角振动跃迁以考察构象特异性发射。
AI.result: 两种构象的电子跃迁被分辨；对角振动分支比为0.91–0.93，显示良好光学循环特性；激发近扭转势垒的非对角跃迁后，发射仍以构象特异为主，表明在激发态荧光寿命内构象身份基本保持。
AI.conclusion: 金属中心光学循环中心可作为内在的、位点特异的分子构象光学报告器，为重复光学读出及单分子水平构象动力学研究提供基础。

title: Dual Action of Electrolyte Additives in High-Voltage Li-Ion Cells
summary: Electrolyte additives have outsized effects on cell performance, but determining their mechanism of action can be difficult. Here, we evaluate whether simple electrochemical tests can reveal which electrode (cathode, anode or both) is targeted by specific additives. Our experiments quantified the rates of reductive and oxidative side-reactions in NMC532 vs. graphite cells containing 12 different electrolyte formulations. We found that gains in interphasial stability were highly correlated, with successful additives decreasing both types of side-reactions by similar magnitude. This dual action could be indicative of the role of crosstalk on cell degradation, as soluble species formed on one electrode can decompose at the other end of the cell. Although electrochemical tests are insufficient for understanding mechanisms of improvement, they can reveal interesting effects that complement other characterization tools.

AI.tldr: 该研究用简单电化学测试量化12种电解液添加剂在NMC532/石墨电池中抑制还原性与氧化性副反应的能力，发现有效添加剂同时降低两类副反应，提示电极间串扰在降解中的作用。
AI.motivation: 电解液添加剂对电池性能影响显著，但确定其作用于正极、负极还是二者兼有以及作用机制较困难，作者希望评估简单电化学测试能否揭示添加剂靶向电极。
AI.method: 在含12种电解液配方的NMC532/石墨电池中，分别量化还原性和氧化性副反应速率，并比较添加剂对两类界面稳定性的改善程度及相关性。
AI.result: 界面稳定性提升高度相关，成功添加剂以相近幅度同时降低还原性和氧化性副反应；这种双重作用可能反映串扰，即一极形成的可溶物种在另一极分解。
AI.conclusion: 简单电化学测试不足以解释添加剂改善机制，但可揭示有价值的作用效果，并与其他表征工具互补。

title: Triplet adiabatic potential energy surfaces for the O($^3$P) + C$_2$(X$^1\Sigma_g^+$, a$^3\Pi_u$) reaction and quasiclassical trajectory dynamics
summary: We present three global adiabatic potential energy surfaces (PESs) for the O($^3$P) + C$_2$(X $^1\Sigma_g^+$, a $^3\Pi_u$) to CO(X$^1\Sigma^+$) + C($^3$P) reaction, computed at the icMRCI+Q/aug-cc-pVTZ level. This reaction is relevant to combustion chemistry, atmospheric processes, and astrochemistry. Since the energy difference between the $^1\Sigma_g^+$ and $^3\Pi_u$ states of C$_2$ is smaller than the zero-point energy, both states mix upon interaction with the approaching O atom. Consequently, the PESs exhibit a double-well topography in the reactant valley. Beyond this feature, the three PESs display markedly different topographies. The 1 $^3A''$ PES features a deep minimum 7.16 eV below the O + C$_2$ entrance channel. In contrast, the 2 $^3A''$ and 1 $^3A'$ surfaces possess shallower collinear wells ($\approx$ 5.7 eV) and strong angular anisotropy arising from avoided crossings with higher-lying triplet states. The analytical fits reproduce the \textit{ab initio} data with root-mean-square (RMS) deviations of 0.022--0.028 eV over an energy interval exceeding 13 eV. Quasiclassical trajectory (QCT) calculations reveal higher reactivity on the barrierless $1\,^3A''$ surface compared to the $2\,^3A''$ PES, where an angle-dependent entrance barrier reduces the cross sections. Furthermore, cross sections for reactions initiated from C$_2$(X $^1\Sigma_g^+$) and C$_2$(a $^3\Pi_u$) are remarkably similar for the three PESs, regardless of the initial rovibrational state.

AI.tldr: 该文构建了O(3P)+C2(X 1Σg+, a 3Πu)→CO(X 1Σ+)+C(3P)反应的三套全局绝热势能面，并用准经典轨迹计算揭示不同三体电子态的 reactivities 差异。
AI.motivation: 该反应与燃烧化学、大气过程和天体化学相关；C2的X 1Σg+与a 3Πu能差小于零点能，与O接近时发生混合，导致反应物谷出现双势阱，需要精确全局PES和动力学研究。
AI.method: 在icMRCI+Q/aug-cc-pVTZ水平计算三套全局绝热PES，并进行解析拟合；随后开展准经典轨迹（QCT）计算，比较1 3A''、2 3A''和1 3A'表面的反应性。
AI.result: 三套PES形貌显著不同：1 3A''有无入口势垒的深极小，位于O+C2入口通道下方7.16 eV；2 3A''和1 3A'具有约5.7 eV的较浅共线势阱及由与高位三重态避免交叉引起的强角各向异性。拟合RMS偏差为0.022–0.028 eV，覆盖超过13 eV能量范围。QCT显示1 3A''反应性高于2 3A''，后者存在角度依赖入口势垒而降低截面；由C2(X 1Σg+)和C2(a 3Πu)引发的截面在三套PES上非常相似，且与初始振转态无关。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了可用于动力学模拟的全局PES，并表明C2电子态混合导致的双势阱特征及不同三体PES的入口势垒/避免交叉形貌控制反应性；初始C2电子态对总截面影响很小。

title: A Heterogeneous CPU-GPU Framework for Finite Element Micromagnetic Simulations on Tetrahedral Meshes
summary: The design of magnetic storage materials relies on repeated micromagnetic simulations. Within each simulation, the demagnetization field evaluation and the sparse linear solve are executed at every time step and together dominate the computational cost. To address these bottlenecks, we develop a heterogeneous CPU-GPU framework that exploits the complementary computational capabilities of the two processors. In the existing AFEMAG solver, developed by Yang et al [J. Comput. Phys. 431 (2021) 110142], computationally intensive boundary integral evaluations and sparse linear solves limit performance. We offload these operations to the GPU while retaining assembly and iteration control on the CPU. We validate the framework using cases from all five $\mu$Mag standard problems, covering quasistatic hysteresis, equilibrium configurations, field-driven dynamics, and spin-transfer-torque dynamics. This approach accelerates simulations across the benchmark suite; notably, for Standard Problem 3 on a mesh of 137,313 nodes, augmenting the CPU with one NVIDIA A100 GPU yields a $17.1\times$ speedup over the CPU-only configuration. The heterogeneous AFEMAG framework thus provides an efficient and practical platform for micromagnetic simulations in the design of magnetic storage materials.

AI.tldr: 提出异构CPU-GPU框架AFEMAG，将退磁场边界积分计算和稀疏线性求解卸载到GPU，从而加速微磁仿真。
AI.motivation: 磁存储材料设计依赖大量微磁仿真，而每个时间步中的退磁场评估和稀疏线性求解是主要计算瓶颈；现有AFEMAG求解器中边界积分计算和稀疏线性求解限制了性能。
AI.method: 构建CPU-GPU异构计算框架：CPU保留组装和迭代控制，GPU负责计算密集的边界积分评估与稀疏线性求解；并使用五个μMag标准问题验证，覆盖准静态磁滞、平衡态、场驱动动力学和自旋转移矩动力学。
AI.result: 在整个基准测试套件上实现加速；特别是在137,313个节点的标准问题3上，使用一块NVIDIA A100 GPU相比纯CPU配置获得17.1倍加速。
AI.conclusion: 异构AFEMAG框架为磁存储材料设计中的微磁仿真提供了高效且实用的计算平台。

title: A branch-free three-dimensional ghost-cell immersed boundary method with direction-averaged extrapolation kernels
summary: Ghost-cell immersed boundary methods impose the wall boundary condition on a Cartesian grid by assigning values to the grid points just inside the body, the ghost points. A common approach reconstructs the ghost value from an image point, which requires a wall normal for every ghost point. Special treatments are also often required where the interpolation stencil leaves the fluid region, e.g., near thin, concave or highly curved parts of complex bodies. We present a ghost-cell method that needs neither wall normals nor image points. Instead of a single extrapolation direction, the method uses all fluid nodes within 2.5 grid spacings of a ghost point that satisfy a simple geometric condition. The ghost value is obtained as the average of one-dimensional linear extrapolations from these nodes through the wall crossings of the connecting segments. The weights depend only on the geometry and are computed offline as one kernel on a $5 \times 5 \times 5$ stencil per ghost point. The boundary treatment at run time is thus an explicit, branch-free weighted sum. For the flows around a sphere and the Stanford Bunny, a self-convergence study shows approximately second-order convergence of the velocity in the $L_1$ and $L_2$ norms. The maximum difference also decreases at second order for the sphere but more slowly for the Stanford Bunny, where it is observed at a few nodes next to the wall. The drag coefficient of the sphere at Reynolds numbers of 25--200 agrees with a previous study within 2.4% for 32 grid cells per diameter and 0.4% for 64. For the Stanford Bunny at a Reynolds number of 100, the force coefficients agree with a body-fitted solution within 1% for 64 grid cells per reference length, without any geometry-specific treatment. Although no pressure condition is imposed on the wall, the pressure field is smooth and consistent with the body-fitted solution.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需壁面法向和镜像点的 ghost-cell 浸入边界方法，通过预计算几何权重在 5×5×5 模板上实现无分支加权求和，并在复杂几何绕流中验证精度与效率。
AI.motivation: 传统 ghost-cell 浸入边界法通常需要为每个 ghost 点构造镜像点和壁面法向，并在薄壁、凹形或强曲率复杂几何附近对插值模板越出流体区域进行特殊处理，流程复杂且依赖几何。
AI.method: 该方法不使用单一外推方向或镜像点，而是选取 ghost 点 2.5 倍网格间距内满足简单几何条件的全部流体节点；对每个节点，沿连接 ghost 点与流体节点的线段经壁面交点作一维线性外推，再取平均得到 ghost 值。权重仅由几何决定，可离线在每 ghost 点的 5×5×5 模板上预计算为一个卷积核，运行时边界处理为显式、无分支的加权和。
AI.result: 对球和 Stanford Bunny 的自收敛研究表明速度在 L1、L2 范数下近似二阶收敛；最大误差对球为二阶下降，对 Bunny 下降较慢且集中于壁面附近少数节点。球在 Re=25–200 时阻力系数与已有研究在每直径 32 网格下相差 2.4% 内、64 网格下 0.4% 内；Bunny 在 Re=100、每参考长度 64 网格下力系数与贴体解相差 1% 内，且无需几何特定处理。虽未施加壁面压力条件，压力场光滑且与贴体解一致。
AI.conclusion: 该 ghost-cell 方法避免壁面法向、镜像点和复杂几何特殊处理，具有实现简单、运行时高效且对复杂几何稳健的特点，并在典型绕流问题中保持二阶精度和良好力/压力预测。

title: A Quantum Genetic Algorithm for Optimization of Benchmark Test Functions using Entangled Qutrits
summary: Typically, quantum genetic algorithms are based on qubits, a two-level quantum system. This work investigates the optimization of Rastrigin, Rosen-Brock and Table Holder Function in comparison with Classical Genetic Algorithm (CGA), using two quantum approaches: Quantum Genetic Algorithm (QGA), and Higher-Order Quantum Genetic Algorithm (HO-QGA) based on qutrits, a three-level system. HO-QGA uses higher-dimensional quantum representations, such as entangled qutrits, to test its capability of enhanced optimization. We show that the QGA convergence rate is higher than the CGA, and the solution quality is considerably improved. Based on this study, a three-state quantum object novelly provides more capabilities than qubits in terms of computational and information resources.

AI.tldr: 该文比较经典遗传算法（CGA）、基于量子比特的量子遗传算法（QGA）以及基于三能级qutrit的高阶量子遗传算法（HO-QGA）在Rastrigin、Rosenbrock和Table Holder函数优化中的表现。
AI.motivation: 传统量子遗传算法多基于二能级qubit，作者希望检验更高维量子表示（如纠缠qutrit）是否能提升优化能力与信息/计算资源利用。
AI.method: 采用CGA、QGA和HO-QGA对三个基准函数进行优化对比；HO-QGA使用三能级qutrit及更高维量子表示，并利用纠缠qutrit测试增强优化效果。
AI.result: QGA的收敛速度高于CGA，解的质量也显著改善；基于qutrit的HO-QGA进一步展示了三态量子对象相较qubit在计算和信息资源方面的更多能力。
AI.conclusion: 高维量子表示（qutrit）为量子遗传算法提供了优于qubit的优化潜力，说明三态量子系统在计算与信息处理资源上具有额外优势。
